functionalReqs: Create, append to and read files
ls on a directory (sorted) or a file
Delete and move files and directories
File metadata: size, created and modified time
hints: Files and directories share some behaviour. Which pattern treats them uniformly?
Resolve a path by walking a tree of name → node maps.

Composite: abstract FsNode (name, parent, metadata), File (content buffer), Directory (TreeMap of children); FileSystem facade with path parsing; mv re-parents a node; per-directory read-write locks or a global lock with justification; permissions as a stretch.
problemStatement: Design an **in-memory file system** supporting `mkdir`, `ls`, `addContentToFile`, `readContentFromFile`, `rm` and `mv` on Unix-style paths.
title: Design an In-memory File System
